# prism-serpent Specification

<!-- Generated by Prism from prism/spec.json. Change the app through your agent with /prism, not by editing this file. -->

## Purpose

Prism Serpent Neon Sovereign: Decides the tactical serpent directive, relic resonance state, rival interception posture, and open-world shrine response across the Neon Sovereign arena and frontier biomes.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Always relic-ascension when pickup is apex-crown

The app SHALL answer `relic-ascension` when pickup is apex-crown, because Apex Crown relics unconditionally take top priority across both arena and open-world modes.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (PROP-001, theorem `prop001Holds`).

#### Scenario: PROP-001 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `arena apex-crown interceptor nexus-bowl overdrive 85 40` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `relic-ascension`
- **AND** the app answers `relic-ascension`, decided by REQ-001

### Requirement: Always evasive-phase when pickup is phase-cloak and threat is at least 60

The app SHALL answer `evasive-phase` when pickup is phase-cloak and threat is at least 60, because High-threat phase cloak activation guarantees evasive phase protection.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (PROP-002, theorem `prop002Holds`).

#### Scenario: PROP-002 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `arena phase-cloak pack-hunter crystalline-spire cruise 32 75` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `evasive-phase`
- **AND** the app answers `evasive-phase`, decided by REQ-002

### Requirement: Always frontier-attune when mode is open-world and zone is sanctum-ring and threat is at most 30 and pickup is energy-orb

The app SHALL answer `frontier-attune` when mode is open-world and zone is sanctum-ring and threat is at most 30 and pickup is energy-orb, because Peaceful arrival at Sanctum Ring in open-world mode always attunes the shrine.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (PROP-003, theorem `prop003Holds`).

#### Scenario: PROP-003 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `open-world energy-orb none sanctum-ring cruise 28 15` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `frontier-attune`
- **AND** the app answers `frontier-attune`, decided by REQ-003

### Requirement: Never apex-dominance when threat is at least 60

The app SHALL NOT answer `apex-dominance` when threat is at least 60, because Apex dominance is never advised under severe collision threat (>= 60).

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (PROP-004, theorem `prop004Holds`).

#### Scenario: PROP-004 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `arena phase-cloak pack-hunter crystalline-spire cruise 32 75` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL NOT be `apex-dominance`
- **AND** the app answers `evasive-phase`, decided by REQ-002

### Requirement: Always evasive-phase when mode is arena and pickup is energy-orb and rival is pack-hunter and boost is cruise and threat is at least 65

The app SHALL answer `evasive-phase` when mode is arena and pickup is energy-orb and rival is pack-hunter and boost is cruise and threat is at least 65, because Unboosted arena serpents pressed by pack-hunters at >= 65 threat always evade.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (PROP-005, theorem `prop005Holds`).

#### Scenario: PROP-005 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `arena energy-orb pack-hunter solaris-rift cruise 24 72` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `evasive-phase`
- **AND** the app answers `evasive-phase`, decided by REQ-006

### Requirement: Never apex-dominance when mode is open-world

The app SHALL NOT answer `apex-dominance` when mode is open-world, because Open-world exploration never triggers competitive arena apex-dominance.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (PROP-006, theorem `prop006Holds`).

#### Scenario: PROP-006 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `open-world energy-orb none sanctum-ring cruise 28 15` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL NOT be `apex-dominance`
- **AND** the app answers `frontier-attune`, decided by REQ-003

The app SHALL answer `frontier-attune` when mode is open-world and zone is sanctum-ring and threat is at most 30 and no earlier rule matches, because Entering Sanctum Ring under calm threat in open-world mode attunes the central monolith.

The app SHALL answer `evasive-phase` when mode is arena and rival is pack-hunter and threat is at least 65 and no earlier rule matches, because High-threat pack-hunter pincers require immediate evasive vector break.

The app SHALL answer `frontier-attune` when mode is open-world and boost is cruise and threat is at most 25 and no earlier rule matches, because Calm cruising across open-world biomes activates harmonic wayfinding and shrine attunement.

The app SHALL answer `territorial-coil` when length is at least 45 and rival is leviathan and no earlier rule matches, because Mid-to-large serpents encountering a leviathan secure loot clusters by coiling.

### Requirement: Otherwise steady-forage

The app SHALL answer `steady-forage` when no rule matches, because Default balanced cruising posture collects radiant energy orbs without shedding mass.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors.

- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `steady-forage`

### Requirement: The first matching rule decides

The app SHALL try REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-009, REQ-010, REQ-011, REQ-012 in that order, and the first rule that matches SHALL decide.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors.

#### Scenario: Two rules match

- **WHEN** the request is `arena apex-crown interceptor nexus-bowl overdrive 85 40` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `relic-ascension`, decided by REQ-001, the earlier rule

### Requirement: Request and answers

The app SHALL read one request as one line of 7 fields separated by single spaces, in this order, and SHALL answer exactly one of `relic-ascension`, `evasive-phase`, `frontier-attune`, `apex-dominance`, `intercept-cut`, `hyper-surge`, `magnet-harvest`, `chrono-cascade`, `territorial-coil`, `steady-forage`, or `invalid` for anything else.

| Field | Accepts | Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `arena`, `open-world` | Active game mode: competitive neon arena or multi-biome open-world exploration |
| `pickup` | `energy-orb`, `hyper-core`, `magnet-prism`, `phase-cloak`, `chrono-shard`, `apex-crown` | Active or nearest collected orb or special relic object |
| `rival` | `none`, `forager`, `interceptor`, `leviathan`, `pack-hunter` | Nearest rival NPC serpent archetype in sensor range |
| `zone` | `nexus-bowl`, `cobalt-dunes`, `crystalline-spire`, `solaris-rift`, `sanctum-ring` | Current spatial arena sector or open-world frontier biome |
| `boost` | `cruise`, `overdrive` | Current thruster propulsion state |
| `length` | whole number from 1 up to 200 | Current articulated serpent body segment count |
| `threat` | whole number from 0 up to 100 | Proximity hazard and rival encroachment index from 0 to 100 |

| Answer | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `relic-ascension` | Trigger shockwave pulse, shrine harmonic burst, and sovereign score surge |
| `evasive-phase` | Engage phase-shift lateral slipstream to evade imminent rival or hazard impact |
| `frontier-attune` | Synchronize serpent dorsal frequency with nearby open-world prism monolith shrine |
| `apex-dominance` | Command central arena lane with overdrive pressure and wide leaderboard lead |
| `intercept-cut` | Accelerate ahead of rival heading vector to force a lateral cut-off takedown |
| `hyper-surge` | Channel zero-drain hyper-core propulsion with expanded chase camera field of view |
| `magnet-harvest` | Project wide-radius orbital pull field to sweep radiant energy balls |
| `chrono-cascade` | Amplify orb growth and score harmonic multiplier across consecutive pickups |
| `territorial-coil` | Form defensive perimeter coil around high-density loot cluster against leviathans |
| `steady-forage` | Maintain balanced cruising cadence while harvesting ambient energy balls |
| `invalid` | the request is malformed |

Verified: reading a request is tested, not proved.

#### Scenario: A malformed request is invalid

- **WHEN** the request is not 7 fields in this order
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `invalid`

## What is proved and what is tested

Lean proves each property marked proved above, for every request that decodes, with no exceptions and no sampling. The proof is about `judge`, the function the WebAssembly guest runs, because both come from the same model.

The parsing of requests is tested, not proved: the acceptance vectors in the app replay through the built guest, including malformed and oversized requests.

Nothing here says the rules are the right rules. That is the part only you can judge.

## Files

- `prism/spec.json` is this spec as data, the app's one input, in canonical JSON (RFC 8785). The model is rendered from it alone, so the same spec.json always gives the same model.
- `src/PrismSerpent.lex.tex` is the LexLean model generated from it. It is the single source of the app.
